note: Text Field Formatter provides one field formatter, id text_field_formatter ('Text field formatter'), for string fields; it extends core StringFormatter and wraps the value in an HTML tag with configurable classes/attributes. Settings: wrap_tag (default _none; div/h1-h6/span, never 'a'), wrap_class (space/comma-separated), wrap_attributes (one attribute|value per line), override_link_label (token-aware, only with link_to_entity). Stored in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field> type text_field_formatter + settings. Available wrap tags are alterable via hook_default_wrap_tags_alter(). No config UI, no permissions, no Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the real entity_view_display formatter config; each uses a namespaced string field on Article (field_tff_*).

evals.prompt: What does the text_field_formatter module's field formatter do, and which field type can it be applied to?
evals.expected_output: It adds a 'Text field formatter' (id text_field_formatter) for string fields that extends core's String formatter, wrapping the value in a chosen HTML tag with configurable CSS classes and attributes.

evals.prompt: Which formatter settings does text_field_formatter add for controlling the HTML wrapper around a string field's value?
evals.expected_output: wrap_tag (the wrapper element: div, h1-h6, span; default _none), wrap_class (space/comma-separated CSS classes), wrap_attributes (one attribute|value per line), plus override_link_label (used with link_to_entity).

evals.prompt: How can another module add an extra wrapper tag option (for example 'p') to the text_field_formatter, and is there a tag the formatter refuses to use?
evals.expected_output: Implement hook_default_wrap_tags_alter(array &$wrappers) to add (e.g. $wrappers['p'] = t('P')) or remove tags. The formatter refuses the 'a' tag (it is stripped with a warning) to avoid clashing with the link-to-entity feature.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a string field field_tff_known displayed with the text_field_formatter. Inspect the live view-display configuration and report the wrapper HTML tag (wrap_tag) configured for it.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_tff_known component has type text_field_formatter with settings.wrap_tag = h2.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a string field field_tff_class shown with the text_field_formatter. Inspect the live view-display configuration and report the wrapper CSS class(es) (wrap_class) configured for it.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_tff_class component (type text_field_formatter) has settings.wrap_class = ribbon (with wrap_tag span).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a string field field_tff_task. Configure Article's default view display so this field is rendered with the text_field_formatter, wrapping the value in a <div> with the CSS class 'callout'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_tff_task component has type text_field_formatter with settings.wrap_tag 'div' and settings.wrap_class containing 'callout'.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a string field field_tff_task2. Configure Article's default view display to render it with the text_field_formatter using a <span> wrapper that carries the HTML attribute data-role=note (via the formatter's wrapper attributes). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_tff_task2 component has type text_field_formatter, settings.wrap_tag 'span', and settings.wrap_attributes containing 'data-role|note'.
